population: Public-evidence or explicitly synthetic small-business workflows requiring a useful local technical/commercial artifact, accurate treatment of uncertainty, and a decision about appropriate retained knowledge.
businessAuthority: Sandbox only. Referencing a public business grants no account, customer, transaction, communication or deployment authority.

cases.selection: Already prepared public/synthetic development scope; not independent
cases.outputScope: Local functional exception-routing project, small commercial handoff, exact bounded repair if warranted
cases.sourceReference: Prepared development packet and its sourcePacketHash; visible fixtures remain excluded from independent evidence

cases.selection: Actual artifact/check/resource observations after development; no invented customer feedback
cases.outputScope: One planner decision; at most one small supported work packet if justified, or a justified rejection

cases.selection: Independent custodian selects one eligible unfamiliar retail/service-exception workflow after source freeze and before any flagship dispatch
cases.outputScope: Usable local multi-file project with current browser/HTTP/persistence verification plus an actionable commercial packet

cases.selection: Independent custodian selects a materially different service-intake/readiness workflow; same case facts for all three arms
cases.outputScope: Complete service packet, fit/precondition/reuse evidence when appropriate, and explicit unsupported obligations

cases.selection: Independent custodian selects an actual candidate-fit challenge after a retained candidate exists; no expected decision or desired answer in worker facts
cases.outputScope: Evidence-grounded applicability decision and useful safe completion or precise blocked branch

cases.selection: Independent custodian selects one complete service workflow matched across two roots from the same frozen adaptive history
cases.outputScope: Two complete workflow artifacts, differing only in access to the pinned retained candidate

excluded: Development fixture answers or scenarios relabeled as independent
A rehearsed obstacle selected because one arm already solved it
Private owner/customer data without actual permission
An artificial instruction to acquire a predetermined package
Tasks requiring external sending, payments, account changes or public deployment
A second full application expected within an eight-call transfer packet budget
custodyBoundary: No final case material or grader answer is included. Future worker packets are independently supplied and hash-bound through whole-chunk binding. A preregistered population or case ID is not proof of independent selection.
